ff132/0.1.0.description:
Initial public release of FF13-2 apworld!

Requires FFModdingWPF FF13-2 standalone rando version 0.8.2.51+ - https://github.com/Bartz24/FFModdingWPF
The standalone rando has a link to the required version of Nova Chrysalia required to install the generated modpacks

To receive items from the client, hold L2 or R2 while in a field area (not the crux/battle)

ff132/0.2.0.description:
Mostly a stabilisation pass to resolve reported issues. Requires the newest available FFModdingWPF Release for compatibility (0.8.2.53+)
https://github.com/Bartz24/FFModdingWPF/releases/tag/pre-release-0.8

AP fixes:
Fix debug log prefix to actually say FF13-2 now to reduce confusion

Associated core rando fixes:
Correct issues with double time duration option on clock puzzles
Add DLC check to generation of an AP modpack to prevent misconfiguration
Script adjustments to ensure that Thorne's Information check can always be obtained even if the associated quest is handed in first
Script adjustments to force that the Archylte sheep are interacted with before allowing the quest to be completed (preventing the checks becoming missable)

Specific check logic fixes:
Correct Yaschas 10 raised area logic
Correct Archylte Grave Ridge (now correctly allows just chocobo access as an access possibility)
Yaschas 1X -> Serendipity area exit now correctly expects a Mog Level
Bresha Ruins 5AF Locked Inside mog levels corrected
ff132/0.2.0.title: FF13-2 AP release 0.2.0

ff132/0.3.0.description:
Featural pass adding almost 30 new checks to the pool!

Requires the newest available FFModdingWPF release for compatibility (version 0.8.2.57+)
https://github.com/Bartz24/FFModdingWPF/releases/tag/pre-release-0.8

Add all Oerba Temporal Rift rewards to the pool (20 checks)
- This is all of the rift puzzles from Oerba 200, 300, and 400.
- The final rift in each of 300 and 400 requires all but one of the fragment items from that area to be in your inventory, instead of just completing the rifts.
- The Oerba 300 Aranaceous Artifact gate also requires 6 of the fragments from Oerba 300 to be in your inventory.

Add all Serendipity fragments to the pool (5 checks, Lucky Coin added but marked as missable/excluded for now until easier adjustment of the success level is added. Casino Coin cost of the buyable fragments reduced significantly for easier logic, this will become an adjustable option in the future)
- A single casino ticket will be enough to buy all of the 3 checks in the shop
- The wild artefact has been removed from the pool due to being inaccessible as a treasure (and therefore not randomisable in the same way, will be added back in eventually).
- Add missing Fragment Skills to the pool (Encounter Master and Chocobo Music have multiple parts that were not fully added, this is now resolved) (4 checks)

Add text indicator in game when there are pending items to be obtained from the AP client

Various logic fixes
- Old Device marked as missable as handing in the fragment quest makes the location permanently inaccessible in a way that script modification is not currently resolving.
- Corrected logic for Raised area in Yaschas Massif - Pass of Paddra (Access to non-10AF or 10AF+Hollow Artefact+Greens location)
ff132/0.3.0.title: FF13-2 AP release 0.3.0
